commands.label: consistent_sqlite_backups
args:
import json, sqlite3, pathlib, os, sys, urllib.parse
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); paths=json.loads((root/'database-paths.json').read_text()); records=[]
for i, path in enumerate(paths):
    source=sqlite3.connect('file:'+urllib.parse.quote(path,safe='/')+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=30)
    result=source.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall()
    if result != [('ok',)]: raise RuntimeError('source database integrity failed')
    target=root/('database-'+str(i)+'.sqlite')
    dest=sqlite3.connect(target); source.backup(dest)
    if dest.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall() != [('ok',)]: raise RuntimeError('backup database integrity failed')
    dest.close(); os.chmod(target,0o600)
    tables=[r[0] for r in source.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name")]
    ids={}
    for name in ('projects','runs'):
        if name not in tables: continue
        columns=[r[1] for r in source.execute('PRAGMA table_info("'+name+'")')]
        if 'id' in columns: ids[name]=[r[0] for r in source.execute('SELECT id FROM "'+name+'" ORDER BY id')]
    records.append({'path':path,'backup':str(target),'integrity':'ok','primary_keys':ids})
    source.close()
(root/'database-backups.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n');os.chmod(root/'database-backups.json',0o600)
print(json.dumps({'databases':len(records),'source_and_backup_integrity':'ok'}))
